description: Rank models by monthly cost for a workload. Use a preset (chatbot, rag, coding_agent, research_agent) or give token numbers.

cached_percent.description: Share of input billed at the cached price, 0-100 (default 50 if steps_per_task>1, else 0)

preset.description: Optional workload preset that fills in token defaults: chatbot, rag, coding_agent, research_agent. Explicit numbers override it.

steps_per_task.description: Model calls per task for multi-step agents (default 1)

name: cheapest_models_for
title: Cheapest models for a workload
